clusters.mechanism: INERT_MEDIA_PATH whitelist only includes five image extensions, so other required inert media (PDF, fonts, audio, video, 3D) are treated as binary and blocked.
modeRequiresAllowance unconditionally flags every changed 100755 file (and exec-bit removal) as binary regardless of content, blocking readable executable text scripts.
PNG parser's fixed chunk whitelist rejects valid ancillary chunks such as tEXt/iTXt/iCCP, so ordinary PNGs with metadata are classified as binary.
Unanchored magic-signature searches (e.g. 'MZ', 'ustar') anywhere in content misclassify readable text as binary.
Classification reads a single large text blob via cat-file --batch without bounding it, exceeding the subprocess output limit and failing.
